cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Which label colour suits these boxes?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Good labels prevent moving-day confusion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'd better choose a colour the driver likes.
